title: Addressing Bias in Generative AI: Challenges and Research Opportunities in Information Management

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual review synthesizing existing literature on bias detection methods (such as embedding-based metrics, probability-based approaches, and counterfactual evaluations) and discussing manifestations in Human Resources and Customer Relationship Management applications.
